name: プロジェクトのページへ移動するAirtableサブナビゲーション
prompt:
Recreate only the supplied Airtable Projects sub-navigation crop as a Japanese-localized image at exactly 285x207 px. Preserve the compact vertical layout, pale peach surface, indentation and active-row treatment. No surrounding sidebar or page content.

At the top left, show a small outline grid/project icon followed by the bold group heading 「プロジェクト」. Beneath it, show one thin vertical guide line along the left of the indented page links. List exactly four links in this order: 「概要」, 「プロジェクトギャラリー」, 「プロジェクトタイムライン」, 「プロジェクトダッシュボード」. The first item 「概要」 is selected: place it in a rounded pale salmon highlight with a slightly stronger thin salmon vertical marker at the left rail. Other items remain unselected on the peach background with medium-gray text.

Use compact 14 px Japanese system sans text, dark charcoal for the group heading and selected label, regular muted-gray text for the remaining links, and about 12 px left indentation from the guide line. Match the source spacing, row heights, and colors. Keep each label on one line and fully visible inside the 285x207 crop. No extra rows, icons, badges, search, buttons, card shadow, or additional page title.
reviewNotes: Needs correction. The first pass preserves the row layout but substitutes a large building icon for the source grid and uses a more saturated peach surface. The second pass corrects the icon and reduces the color intensity.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
